categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Comens New Materials Co., Ltd. operates primarily in five business segments: composite adhesive materials, traffic functional materials, electrical functional materials, low-carbon coating materials, and optical display materials. The composite adhesive materials segment focuses on high-performance polyurethane adhesives for soft packaging and other composite bonding applications. Traffic functional materials include NVH sound insulation and vibration damping materials, automotive adhesives, and battery adhesives. Electrical functional materials cover power equipment potting resins, photovoltaic adhesives, and insulating resins for electrical and electronic devices. Low-carbon coating materials mainly involve powder coating resins, and optical display materials focus on adhesives for polarizing films and cover glass fixation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced polyurethane chemistry and epoxy resin technologies for adhesive and resin products, including solvent-free and water-based formulations. Production methods include multi-step chemical synthesis such as esterification, acidification, and polycondensation for powder coating resins, and precise mixing and curing processes for automotive and electrical adhesives. The company also uses vacuum degassing, high-speed dispersion, and automated packaging technologies. R&D focuses on environmentally friendly, high-performance, and fast-curing adhesives, with patented innovations in solvent-free adhesives, high-temperature resistant PUR, and insulating resins with superior durability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading soft packaging companies in China and Southeast Asia, automotive manufacturers (including major Japanese and domestic brands), power equipment manufacturers, photovoltaic module producers, and electronic appliance manufacturers. The company serves industries such as food and pharmaceutical packaging, automotive interiors and battery assembly, electrical power transmission, renewable energy (solar and wind), and consumer electronics. The company also targets emerging markets like rail transit, new energy vehicles, and optical display panel manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant market presence in North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northeast, and Southwest regions. It has expanded international operations with established offices in Vietnam and Thailand, targeting Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and other emerging markets. Overseas sales accounted for approximately 15% of total revenue in 2024, with a focus on expanding export markets and international customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Comens New Materials is positioned midstream in the chemical materials supply chain, producing specialized adhesive and resin products from petrochemical raw materials sourced from upstream chemical manufacturers. It supplies these materials downstream to packaging converters, automotive OEMs and suppliers, electrical equipment manufacturers, and coating producers. The company manages its own production facilities and maintains direct sales relationships with end customers, emphasizing integrated product and solution offerings.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic R&D priorities include leading development in composite adhesive materials, enhancing traffic functional materials, accelerating growth in electrical functional materials, and breakthrough innovation in optical display materials. It emphasizes environmentally friendly, solvent-free, and high-performance adhesive technologies. R&D efforts focus on fast-curing, high-temperature resistant, and durable products, with strong investment in talent and collaboration with academic institutions. The company also advances digital R&D management systems like PLM and pursues patent protection to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of adhesive products, resins, and related materials to industrial customers. The company employs a direct sales model supported by regional offices and technical service teams. It also earns income from licensing proprietary technologies and receives government subsidies related to innovation and environmental compliance. The company does not rely on subscription or advertising revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a domestic leader in high-performance polyurethane adhesives for soft packaging and holds a strong position in automotive NVH materials and electrical insulating resins. It competes with international and domestic chemical material manufacturers, especially in high-end adhesive markets where foreign companies have advantages. Its subsidiaries have strong competitive positions as Tier 1 suppliers to major automotive OEMs. The company leverages technological innovation, product quality, and long-term customer relationships to maintain market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.18 billion, representing a 14.05% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 135.36 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in 2023. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.32 billion with steady growth in R&D investment (6.94% of revenue). It maintains a positive growth trajectory supported by new capacity projects and expanding international sales. The company’s financial health improved with increased profitability and enhanced operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, environmentally friendly adhesive solutions with strong customization and system integration capabilities. Its solvent-free and water-based adhesives meet stringent safety and environmental standards, differentiating it in the market. The company offers comprehensive technical support and innovative product development tailored to customer needs, ensuring superior bonding strength, durability, and fast curing. Its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and established supply chain partnerships provide competitive advantages in quality, reliability, and service.
